issues.description: The problem statement requires that the set_pixel subroutine receive the alpha channel in EDX ("der Alpha-Kanal in edx"), but the provided template/main does not set EDX before calling set_pixel and the solution implementation does not consume the alpha value from EDX. This is a parameter/contract mismatch: students are told to supply an alpha value via a register, yet neither the template supplies it nor the solution uses it. This can confuse students about whether they must provide an alpha value and how to pass it, and whether set_pixel is expected to use it.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the register contract consistent across artifacts. Either (A) remove the requirement that the alpha channel be passed in EDX from the problem statement (and document that set_pixel only uses ECX for RGB), or (B) update the template (and example solution) so main obtains/initializes an alpha value and stores it into EDX before calling set_pixel, and update the solution to use EDX if intended. Choose (A) if alpha is not part of the exercise, or (B) if alpha handling is required.
